description: This Java class 'GenreStatistics' provides statistical analysis related to book genres within a book tracking application. It includes methods to find the most read genre, the most liked genre, and the least liked genre based on user ratings, by processing a list of books with genre and rating information.

classes.name: GenreStatistics
classes.description: A class that computes statistics related to book genres, such as most read, most liked, and least liked genres, based on a collection of books read.

methods.name: findMostReadGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre that has been read the most across all books, as an Optional.

methods.name: findMostLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the highest total rating across all read books, as an Optional.

methods.name: findLeastLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the lowest total rating across all read books, as an Optional.
